bardanmcguire wrote:
“If you look for meaning, you’ll miss everything that happens” – Andrei Tarkovsky
I understand your point, but i have a tendency to analyze thing to understand their “
true
” meaning, no matter how mundane the thing (it may be a Tarkovsky’s frame or something written on a wall or just a scribble by my son), that’s just how my brain works. Perhaps i’m a bit too rational, but to me it’s more important to understand the meaning of something for its author than my feeling of it. I teach maths and science, i can’t avoid that! ah ah!
